test_title: SSC CGL (2022) Tier-II Official Paper (Held On : 3 March 2023)
subject: general
question: The main theme of the passage is

options.text: increase in the area of Rabi crops in 2022-23
area under rabi crop in last five years
increase in the production of pulses
increase in the area of oilseeds like mustard

solution:
Here the correct answer is **Increase in the area of Rabi crops in 2022-23.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **main theme** of the passage is **the increase in the area of Rabi crops in 2022-23. **
 
• This can be inferred from the first sentence of the passage, which states that the total area sown under Rabi crops has increased by** 3.25%** from **697.98 lakh** **hectares **in** 2021-22** to** 720.68 lakh hectares **in** 2022-23. **
 
• The subsequent sentences provide details on the increase in area for different crops, including rice, oilseeds, and pulses, but the overarching theme is the increase in the area of Rabi crops.
 
• **Option 2,** which refers to the area under Rabi crop in the last five years, is not the main theme of the passage but is only mentioned as a comparison point to show the extent of the increase in the current year.
 
• **Option 3,** which refers to the increase in the production of pulses, is only briefly mentioned towards the end of the passage and does not constitute the main theme.
 
• **Option 4, **which refers to the increase in the area of oilseeds like mustard, is also mentioned in the passage but is not the main theme.
